2610.09759.title: Unrolled Flow Models for Reasoning
2610.09759.paper_summary: Flow matching enables language generation in few steps, but whether additional integration steps improve reasoning remains unclear. We prove that a flow parameterized by a two-layer Transformer can solve graph reachability, with the required number of integration steps increasing with the target's distance from the root. Yet, standard flow language models can fail to benefit from additional steps on reasoning tasks. We attribute this limitation to objectives that supervise each time point independently, without explicitly training successive steps to build on one another. To address this, we instead train through the model's own latent rollout over a randomly sampled subinterval of [0, 1], decoding only at the endpoint. On ProsQA, this raises accuracy to 97% and enables performance to improve with additional integration steps. For the longer rollouts required by reasoning tasks such as Sudoku and Maze, retracting the latent state onto a sphere stabilizes the dynamics and yields substantial gains over baselines with more than three times as many parameters. Sampling multiple rollouts further improves performance when paired with a parameter-free selection score, although reliable selection remains challenging for longer answers. Together, these results establish a theoretical basis for reasoning with flows and show how rollout training, stable latent dynamics, and rollout selection help realize this capacity in practice.
2610.09759.paper_summary_zh: 流匹配使得語言生成能在少數步驟內完成，但額外的整合步驟是否能改善推理仍不明朗。<lb/>我們證明了一個由兩層Transformer參數化的流可以解決圖的可達性，所需的整合步驟數量隨著目標距離根節點的距離增加而增加。<lb/>然而，標準流語言模型在推理任務上可能無法從額外的步驟中受益。<lb/>我們將這一限制歸因於每個時間點獨立監督的目標，而未明確訓練連續步驟相互依賴。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們改為通過模型自身的潛在展開，在隨機抽樣的[0, 1]子區間內進行訓練，僅在終點進行解碼。<lb/>在ProsQA上，這將準確率提高到97%，並使性能隨著額外的整合步驟而改善。<lb/>對於像數獨和迷宮這樣的推理任務所需的較長展開，將潛在狀態收回到一個球面上穩定了動態，並在參數超過三倍的基準上獲得了顯著的增益。<lb/>當與無參數的選擇分數配對時，採樣多個展開進一步提高了性能，儘管對於較長的答案，可靠的選擇仍然具有挑戰性。<lb/>總體而言，這些結果為使用流進行推理建立了理論基礎，並展示了展開訓練、穩定的潛在動態和展開選擇如何在實踐中實現這一能力。
